report.subject: {issue} at {where}
report.intro: I'd like to report a problem: {issue}.
report.signature: Sent by a resident using WhoseJob? — the resident will attach a photo if they have one.
casework.subject: Request for help with {topic}
casework.intro: I live in Virginia's 8th District and I'm asking for your office's help with {topic}.
casework.privacy: Your office may need my signed privacy release form before contacting the agency. Please let me know how to send it.
app.name: WhoseJob?
app.tagline: Find the office that fixes it
lang.label: Language
progress.label: Step {n} of 5
home.title: Who fixes this?
home.lede: Pick the problem and drop a pin. We'll find the one office that fixes that exact spot in Virginia's 8th District, and write the report for you.
home.federal: Get help with a federal agency
home.federalHint: Passport, VA, Social Security, IRS, immigration
home.coverage: Covers Arlington, Alexandria, Falls Church and the 8th District part of Fairfax County.
home.sendNote: You send every report yourself. Your photo never leaves your phone.
photo.title: Add a photo
photo.lede: A photo helps the office, and it can tell us where the problem is. It stays on your phone.
photo.found: Found the spot from your photo.
photo.noGps: We couldn't read a location from this photo. You'll pick the spot on the map.
issue.title: What's wrong?
where.title: Where is it?
where.lede: Move the map so the pin sits on the problem.
where.notFound: We couldn't find that address. Check the spelling, leave out apartment numbers, or drop a pin.
where.locationDenied: We couldn't get your location. Move the map or type an address.
where.error: We couldn't check this spot right now. Please try again.
answer.title: Here's who fixes it
answer.fixedBy.state: Fixed by a Virginia state agency
answer.fixedBy.federal: Handled by your Member of Congress
answer.verifying: Our team is still double-checking this rule.
answer.fallback.census: A government map service didn't answer, so we used saved map data.
answer.fallback.road: We couldn't check who owns the road right now.
answer.fallback.streetlight: We couldn't find this light in the map data.
poletag.title: Whose light is this?
poletag.lede: Look for a metal tag or sticker on the pole. Does it say Dominion?
out.title: This spot is outside Virginia's 8th District
out.lede: WhoseJob? covers Arlington, Alexandria, Falls Church and part of Fairfax County. This spot is in {district}.
out.ledeUnknown: WhoseJob? covers Arlington, Alexandria, Falls Church and part of Fairfax County.
send.title: Your report
send.lede: Check it, then send it yourself. WhoseJob? never sends anything for you.
send.descHint: For example: dark for three nights.
send.copied: Copied. Paste it into the office's form or email.
send.photoNote: Your photo stays on your phone. Attach it yourself if you'd like.
federal.title: Help with a federal agency
federal.lede: When a federal agency is stuck, your Member of Congress's office can step in. This is called casework.
federal.addressLabel: Your home address (to find your Member of Congress)
federal.descLabel: In a sentence or two, what's going on? Don't include ID or case numbers.
federal.privacy: House offices usually need a signed privacy release before they can contact an agency for you. The office will send you the form.
federal.outside: That address isn't in Virginia's 8th District. Your Member of Congress is {name}.
